svg.title: Track, 16 px fit A
svg.desc: Oath & Action Civic Line CL-020 Track, pixel-fit master for 16 px, fit A: a 1 px line drawn pixel by pixel on the 16 px grid, every feature and red placement of the master kept, the red its own shape in the accent group (DR-133, stage B). Use at 16 px only; the black edition is the one in use under 48 px.
